issue.title: Record historical feature and service replacement decisions
issue.build: Give every retired or service-dependent Arc feature an explicit downstream disposition.
accept: Cover Notes, Reader Mode beta, Paste & Go, Recent Tab indicator, Command Bar education, GitHub Previews, iCloud sync, Legacy Boost Builder, Ask on Page and Arc sunset/migration. Also cover People Cards and historical Favorite-site previews.
For each, record implement/replace/import/defer with the surviving workflow and evidence; separately record Dia Memory's conflicting status.
Keep mobile Arc Search features, Dia work connectors/decks and unavailable vendor services explicit scope decisions rather than silently claiming desktop parity.

The owner excluded iCloud and new cross-device sync. Keep local import/export and migration without an Arcified account; record that explicit disposition instead of planning a replacement sync backend.
issue.readiness: Proposed work after native/reference prerequisites and explicit decisions in this issue.
issue.disposition: Historical/retired reference. Recommended replacement or decision, not current runtime parity.
issue.referencePlatforms: Arc feature evidence is macOS-heavy or macOS-only as recorded in the dossier. Windows parity is not assumed; Linux is a downstream design target.
issue.referenceNote: The linked reference documents/release histories describe this workflow family. Acceptance below specifies the intended improved Arcified behavior.
issue.openQuestions: Native integration, failure behavior and applicable platform results must be proven for this slice; unavailable checks stay open.

rootOwns: Shared native build tree, heavy tests, integrated patch registration, remote publication, PR state and final acceptance.

manifestUpdateDuringResearch.effect: Assignment/command unchanged; actual settings verified. Root added cross-area dependency records.
